quartz.rationale: The legacy adapter has explicit registered goals and no registered required goals or deliverables to fail. Loaded predicate condition 1 instead derives requirements from the signed order: optional G4 cannot cover R8, and R3 and R5 are unrepresented.

maple.rationale: The registered required goals and deliverables pass the legacy adapter. Loaded predicate condition 1 uses the signed-order domain and blocks completion because the mandatory printable sampling checklist, R3, is unrepresented.

orchid.rationale: The signed amendment replaces R5 with R6, and all current mandatory outcomes have passing required goals and usable outputs. Under condition 6, X16 does not bind this order.

linen.rationale: All mandatory outputs are verified, so the registry-local legacy adapter passes. Condition 6 and the final-transition authority guard block publication: S81 binds this order and became durable before any notification was committed.
